note: M1 mine contract deployment. Public on-chain ids only — NO secrets. The deployer/admin is the dedicated `mir2-onchain-mine` testnet wallet; its key stays in the local Sui keystore.

1.note: smoke mine — hit/drop 100/100 makes the roll deterministic for verification; real rates (e.g. Crystal 25/10) are admin-settable via admin_system::set_mine

verifiedOnChain.mineBatch: ore_balance[deployer,BlackIron]=5, stones_left[1]=5, miner_nonce=1, emitted_this_epoch=5; mine_settled_event emitted
verifiedOnChain.replayGuard: re-sending nonce=1 aborts with BadNonce (Replay or out-of-order nonce)
verifiedOnChain.depletion: nonce=2 mined remaining stones -> stones_left=0 + MineDepletedEvent
